  The access key for decrypting the password at the bank or anyone will require the two  
  prime numbers used for generating the public key, which only the bank can have.  
  Consider a hypothetical situation where in the futuristic year 2035 a company, X built a  
  Quantum computer with 100,000 qubits. Supposedly, you have an access to that  
  computer and you are given a challenge for ethical hacking to find the two prime  
  numbers to test the vulnerability of the password. Analyse the situation and explain an  
  algorithm, which you would use with appropriate mathematical justifications to test the  
  vulnerability of the password.  
  
  C)       Alice wants to send two classical bits 01 to Bob using a single qubit. What gates Alice  
  will have to apply to the entangled bit in her possession in the Bell state and why?        (2)
